scientific_question: Does retaining ordered camera-pair identity, six target-ray depth bins, signed residual phase and exact cross-camera viewing angle provide enough truth-aware span capacity to remove the independently verified v139 five-camera observation tail under the unchanged 2A+2AT online shell?

advisor_alignment.direction: Use controlled reaction-flow CFD and a variable-cardinality virtual multi-camera BOS forward before one-time migration to laboratory data.
advisor_alignment.camera_stress: The parent roster contains 5, 7, 9 and 12 active cameras, camera-order changes, observation noise, extrinsic error, intrinsic error and combined perturbations.
advisor_alignment.future_real_data: Laboratory displacement images, calibration, masks and repeated-measurement noise are not yet available and remain outside v140.

prior_result.interpretation: v139 compressed peer cameras into leave-one-out consensus/disagreement and twelve depth samples into fixed P1/P2 moments. v140 tests whether the discarded ordered-pair and depth-bin structure explains the remaining observation tail.

data_contract.role: post-open fit-only pair-resolved representation capacity diagnostic

representation_contract.parent_basis: Exactly the complete v139 72C direction basis retained as the prefix.
representation_contract.visible_inputs: The active-camera zero-start CGLS K1 residual, predicted correction dual and every active camera's reported 18-value geometry token.
representation_contract.target_ray_domain: Each reported target detector ray is clipped to the normalized reconstruction cube [-1,1]^3 and sampled at the same twelve midpoint nodes as v139.
representation_contract.peer_residual_lift: Lift each peer camera's two signed detector residual components into world coordinates with that peer pixel's exact reported transverse basis.
representation_contract.pair_reprojection: For every ordered target-peer pair, reproject each target-ray sample into the exact reported peer detector, bilinearly sample the peer world residual and peer ray direction, then project the residual onto the target pixel's exact reported transverse basis.
representation_contract.support_rule: Invalid reprojections contribute zero. Each two-sample bin is divided by the fixed bin size two rather than by valid count, retaining partial-support magnitude.
representation_contract.angle_definition: The constant branch has weight one. The second branch has weight 2 sin(theta)^2 - 1, where theta is the acute angle between the exact reported target ray and the bilinearly sampled normalized peer ray.
representation_contract.phase_scale: For each target camera and displacement component, compute one RMS from all ordered-peer, depth-bin and detector pixels in the constant branch. Use this same positive scale for both branches; tanh(raw/scale) defines phase. A scale at most 1e-30 fails closed.
representation_contract.spectral_carrier: Multiply each phase map by only the target camera/component low-low v133 detector-spectral direction. No high-frequency carrier or truth-selected carrier is added.
representation_contract.direction_order: All v139 parent directions, then target-major, peer-major excluding target, component-major, depth-bin-major and angle-branch-major pair directions.
representation_contract.strict_containment: Zero pair coefficients reproduce every v139 candidate exactly.
representation_contract.camera_permutation_equivariance: Permuting active cameras permutes ordered-pair directions and outputs; the represented span is unchanged.
representation_contract.boundary_and_tie_break: Projection coordinates use the inherited 2e-12 tolerance and fixed bilinear low-index-first interpolation. Equal candidate scores use frozen roster order.
representation_contract.deployment_boundary: The pair representation is deployment-visible. Truth-aware coefficients and candidate selection are capacity-only and are not a deployable estimator.

stage_a.purpose: Falsify the representation on the fixed independently verified v139 hard-failure roster before spending compute on the full tail.
stage_a.oracle_scope: Run the seven frozen projection-Pareto truth-aware endpoints only on these 151 indices.
stage_a.cheap_control_scope: Run one deployment-visible pair-depth joint ridge control on the same 151 indices.
stage_a.pass_rule: All 151 selected candidates must satisfy all four per-cell ratios at or below 1.05 after exact physical replay.
stage_a.failure_action: Close this exact ordered-pair six-bin two-angle representation. Do not run Stage B and do not train a predictor or larger neural model.
stage_a.success_action: Authorize only Stage B. Do not claim full capacity, a deployable algorithm, speed, generalization or a breakthrough.

stage_b.purpose: If Stage A passes, evaluate the fixed v139 active tail required to establish the complete 3700-cell and five-trajectory gate.
stage_b.roster_definition: Every cell for which any independently validated v139 selected metric divided by K4 exceeds 1.02.
stage_b.inactive_parent_retention: Cells outside the active tail retain their independently validated v139 candidate; each already has every metric ratio at or below 1.02.
stage_b.required_output: Merge all active-tail physical replays with inactive v139 parents and report 3700 per-cell gates plus each complete trajectory's metric p90-higher and worst.
stage_b.cheap_control_requirement: If the Stage-A cheap control passes, run its complete all-cell no-harm and trajectory-tail evaluation before attributing any benefit to truth-aware pair-depth capacity.

objective_roster.finite_weight_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher field-lift error plus projection_weight times relative squared teacher projected-lift error.
objective_roster.projection_only_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher projected-lift error with zero field weight.
objective_roster.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of each unregularized weighted Gram matrix.
objective_roster.formal_solver: float64 direct solve of regularized normal equations
objective_roster.independent_solver: float64 symmetric eigendecomposition of independently reconstructed equations
objective_roster.canonicalization: Normalize coefficients to unit RMS and orient toward nonnegative projected-target inner product.
objective_roster.selector: Prefer all-four-metric feasibility by minimum worst ratio, then observation ratio and roster order; otherwise physical feasibility and minimum observation; otherwise physical minimax.
objective_roster.truth_boundary: Teacher targets, metrics and selector use only already-opened fit truth to measure representation capacity.

cheap_control.name: deployment-visible pair-depth residual joint ridge LS
cheap_control.definition: For each target camera/component jointly fit its 36 v139 parent directions and 12(C-1) pair-depth directions to the visible K1 residual, concatenate and normalize to unit coefficient RMS.

call_accounting.candidate_online_shell: zero-start CGLS K1 plus one selected exact AT lift and one exact A projection
call_accounting.representation_cost: Reported-ray reprojection, bilinear detector sampling, fixed detector-space phase construction and finite linear algebra only; no extra exact operator call.
call_accounting.offline_capacity_work: Truth-aware batched lifts, seven solves and scoring are excluded from deployment cost claims.

decision_rule.stage_a_fail: Record an independently validated negative result and close v140 without Stage B or training.
decision_rule.stage_a_pass: Run a separately frozen Stage B on the fixed 2199 active-tail roster.
decision_rule.stage_b_pass: Only 3700/3700 and all 5 trajectory tails, with no cheaper deterministic explanation, may authorize a separately frozen minimal permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only coefficient predictor under complete-trajectory LOTO.
decision_rule.inference_limit: Stage-A success is not full capacity. Full capacity is not prediction. Prediction is not wall/RSS speedup, external generalization, curved-ray validation or real-BOST validation.
